===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪˌlɛkˈtɹɑnɪk ˈsɪɡəˌɹɛt/|a=US}}<!--although possibly also in all the other ways the individual words can be pronounced-->
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-electronic cigarette.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[battery-powered]] [[device]] used to [[vaporize]] substances, primarily [[nicotine]], for recreative [[inhalation]].
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:electronic cigarette}}
#* {{RQ:NYT|en|date=2015-01-18|author=w:Sally Satel|title=Will the F.D.A. kill off e-cigs?|url=http://www.nytimes.com/2015/01/19/opinion/will-the-fda-kill-off-e-cigs.html
|passage='''Electronic cigarettes''', battery-powered devices that convert a solution of nicotine and other chemicals into a vapor that can be inhaled, or "vaped," have the potential to wean a vast number of smokers off cigarettes. {{...}} The problem is, not enough smokers are switching to e-cigarettes, despite their relative safety – and understandably so. Smokers are barraged with news about inaccurate labeling, shoddy counterfeits and poorly made e-cigarettes that emit toxins and cancer-causing chemicals in vapor.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251003233652/https://www.nytimes.com/2015/01/19/opinion/will-the-fda-kill-off-e-cigs.html|archivedate=3 October 2025}}
